name: level1-lose-arrest
description: Level 1 losing scenario: heavy corruption and mafia use, triggering criminal arrest. The full trajectory is more interesting than the name alone suggests: mafia smuggling's $8000/tick income (MafiaActions.ts's SMUGGLE_BASE_INCOME) is so lucrative that the level's own profit-threshold win condition fires first (levelEndReason:'completed' at tick 20) -- arrest doesn't happen until tick 50, by which point the level has already been won. Confirmed via direct trace; see the note on the second tick 10 step and the final campaign status step.

expect.note: toggling smuggling ON is free and instant -- the $8000/tick income (SMUGGLE_BASE_INCOME, MafiaActions.ts) only starts accruing once ticking resumes, checked on the next tick step. This single toggle is the whole reason the level ends in a win before arrest ever triggers -- see the file's own top-level description.
confirmed via direct trace: smuggling's $8000/tick over 10 ticks ($80,000) minus payroll for the 2 employees swings cash from -7500 to +71200 -- not yet enough to trip the level's profit threshold.
